scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:test: npm run wasm:testbed && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode test
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --release --features testbed --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --release --all-targets --all-features --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run build:test && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:prod
